explication: pprof accepts local or HTTP profiling data, optionally combines profiles and symbolizes addresses, then analyzes samples into text or graphical reports. The main command also offers interactive terminal and HTTP interfaces for refining and viewing results. The graph preserves documented capabilities whose implementations were not sampled; links for those are limited to relationships established by the README or sampled code.
